ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central lobe regions versus 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at the periphery and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large bilaterally symmetrical white patches in lobe centers. Black perimeter bands are wider at the tips. Left lobe exhibits high-density black speckling in the lower-quadrant. Right lobe contains sparse, semi-circular dark motifs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression; estimated pixel angle of 135 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along 90% of the visible trailing edge; amplitude varies from 5 to 20 pixels; distinct 'saw-tooth' pattern most prominent on the medial-superior sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending to the tips; the trailing edge follows a non-linear, upwardly-curving path ending in acute-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 5 high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) clustered in the dark pigmentation just below the median notch. Multiple dark circular spots distributed across the white ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct dark horizontal linear disruption on the mid-lower section of the left lobe; multiple fine, vertical high-contrast scratches near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged indentations on the trailing edge suggestive of past tissue loss. Dense clusters of sessile barnacles on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy calcified encrustations on the tips and trailing edge margins, creating a textured, multi-colored protrusion against the dark skin.
